issue_context.title: AladdinConnect key expiration error in logs
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Was looking in the logs and saw this error. The integration once installed doesn't have anywhere to login again to see if that would fix. I did remove integration and log back in to see if that fixes issue.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.7.6

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Supervised

### Integration causing the issue

AlladinConnect

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/aladdin_connect

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
Logger: AIOAladdinConnect
Source: /usr/local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/AIOAladdinConnect/__init__.py:147
First occurred: 3:02:20 PM (1 occurrences)
Last logged: 3:02:20 PM

Key has expired
```


### Additional information

_No response_
comments:
Hey there @mkmer, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`aladdin_connect`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L54) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>
The key expires every day (24 hours) and should automatically get a new one.  Is the integration not working?  Does reloading the integration fix the issue if it's not working?

It only gave me the error at 3:30 today and it's now 10:30 with no other error showing. I did have this odd warning
```Logger: homeassistant.helpers.frame
Source: helpers/frame.py:103
First occurred: 5:41:32 PM (2 occurrences)
Last logged: 5:54:32 PM

Detected integration that closes the Home Assistant aiohttp session. Please report issue for aladdin_connect using this method at homeassistant/components/aladdin_connect/cover.py, line 106: await self._acc.close()
Detected integration that closes the Home Assistant aiohttp session. Please report issue for aladdin_connect using this method at homeassistant/components/aladdin_connect/config_flow.py, line 47: await acc.close()
```

I also have a z-wave garage controller so I have that setup in my automations and such. Added this integration as backup and haven't done much with it. I did just check the entity history and twice it's showed unavailable at 5:30 to 6:00 today but in between it showed closed. Only other time this week it became unavailable is 4 days ago at midnight. 

Not sure if any of this is helpful.
Really just a "normal" operation- have changed the API to log key expiration at the info level rather than error level.

review_comments: This should be part of the entity description itself?

For 99% of the models, these are disabled by default.  For this ONE model, two of the three should be enabled when integration is added. 
Is there another way to do that?
